description: This PHP script generates and manages the list view for the Documents module in a vtiger CRM system, including session handling, permissions, folder management, search, sorting, and rendering the list view template.

classes.name: CustomView
classes.description: Handles custom view configurations and permissions for the Documents module.

classes.name: ListViewController
classes.description: Manages list view operations such as header info and entries retrieval.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine wrapper for rendering views.

methods.name: initSortbyField
methods.description: Initializes sorting fields for the Documents module.

methods.name: getViewId
methods.description: Retrieves the current view ID for the custom view.

methods.name: getCustomViewCombo
methods.description: Generates HTML for custom view selection.

methods.name: getCustomViewByCvid
methods.description: Gets details of the custom view by its ID.

methods.name: getOrderBy
methods.description: Returns the current field used for ordering.

methods.name: getSortOrderForFolder
methods.description: Retrieves sort order specific to a folder.

methods.name: getOrderByForFolder
methods.description: Retrieves order by field specific to a folder.

methods.name: getBasicSearchFieldInfoList
methods.description: Provides basic search fields for the list view.

methods.name: getListViewHeader
methods.description: Generates the header for the list view.

methods.name: getListViewEntries
methods.description: Retrieves list view entries for display.
